_comment: LEGACY BENCH CATALOG. The slow-control parameters now come from slow_control_catalog.json (generated from Slow_control_protocol_example.csv), and the FPGA threshold BRAM is generated from the same CSV -- see threshold_tables_pkg.vhd. The four devices below are the pre-CSV CAN/UDP bench devices; they are kept only so traffic from the old test node still shows a human name instead of device_<id>. Their DeviceTypeIDs (268/280/320/332) are not used by the CSV, so they cannot collide with a real parameter. Delete this file's entries once the bench node speaks slow-control identifiers. Keys are the 16 bit identifier ((DeviceTypeID << 6) | DeviceNo) as lowercase hex; lower/upper are the interlock limits in the same Q22.10 the BRAM holds.
